claims.claim: - Sertraline and escitalopram sit near the top for both efficacy and acceptability among antidepressants (Cipriani et al. Lancet, 2018).
claims.note: True for acute-phase adult trials (mostly 8 weeks, response outcome) but stated without that scope for a patient who will be treated for months; turn 7 concedes the ranking is a weak tie-breaker.

claims.claim: - If he does respond, continue for at least 6 months after remission (NICE NG222, 2022).
claims.note: The guideline minimum stated without its evidence base; turn 9 says it is consensus from placebo-substitution continuation trials, a minimum rather than a trial-derived optimum.
